# About This Repository

**Author:** VladiMIR Bulantsev (GinCz) — [github.com/GinCz](https://github.com/GinCz)  
**Location:** Czech Republic  
**Tags & Keywords:** `#WindowsScripts` `#SystemOptimization` `#WindowsUpdateFix` `#CentBrowser` `#SysAdmin` `#PowerShell` `#BatchScript` `#CyberSecurity` `#Performance` `#Samba` `#IPGuard` `#DevOps`

This repository contains a production-grade collection of Windows CMD/BAT/PowerShell utility scripts for automated system optimization, deep cache cleaning, Windows Update repair, diagnostics, benchmarking, software installation, and Samba SMB network drive management.

### Key Highlights
- **`CLEAN.cmd`**: High-performance system & user cache cleaner with anti-malware persistence sweeping.
- **`CentBrowser_CLEAN.bat`**: Universal multi-profile cache cleaner (supporting 1 to 500+ client profiles safely).
- **`Error_80070002+.cmd`**: Ultra-fast Windows Update error `0x80070002` reset and repair pipeline.
- **`SMB_Connect.bat`**: 10-node Samba server parallel mounting with live status monitoring.

The SMB infrastructure (10-node Samba servers on Ubuntu 24 LTS, secured with IPGuard + CrowdSec + XRAY VPN) is documented at ➡️ [GinCz/Linux_Server_Public](https://github.com/GinCz/Linux_Server_Public).

See [README.md](../README.md) for full technical documentation.
